channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: LIVE: Israeli settlers attack West Bank’s Nablus, shooting leaves six dead
item.description: Four Palestinians and two Israelis killed after about 20 settlers raid the village of Tal in occupied West Bank.

item.title: Netanyahu to meet Trump at White House next week amid Iran war escalation
item.description: Visit will be Netanyahu's seventh to White House, underscoring US commitment during war with Iran, genocide in Gaza.

item.title: Five killed in occupied West Bank after Israeli settlers attack
item.description: Four Palestinians and one Israeli were killed in a shooting in the occupied West Bank village of Tal

item.title: At least 21 killed as Ukraine and Russia continue to trade attacks
item.description: Strikes target Ukrainian defence industry event, Russia’s Kirov and more Wildberries warehouses.

item.title: Is the US-Saudi nuclear deal on, or in limbo?
item.description: Trump's last-minute demand for Saudi normalisation with Israel has complicated the already sensitive deal.

item.title: US and Iran trade more strikes in Gulf as fears of escalation mount
item.description: It comes as Iran condemned the US plan to use frozen Iranian assets to pay for war damages.

item.title: Four Palestinians and two Israelis killed in West Bank shooting
item.description: Palestinians say villagers came under attack by settlers, while the Israeli military says a Palestinian stole a weapon and opened fire on hikers.

item.title: Oil prices hit $100 for the first time since May
item.description: The price of Brent crude rose more than 6% on Thursday as the war in the Middle East continues to escalate.

item.title: Saudis must recognise Israel for nuclear deal, says Trump
item.description: The US president says the landmark agreement to help Saudis develop nuclear energy is dependent on it joining the Abraham Accords.

item.title: Houthi attacks raise fears of wider Middle East conflict and more global economic damage
item.description: The Iran-backed group in Yemen has threatened to target Saudi vessels in a vital shipping route.
